questions.question: Joab fought Rabbah and told David to come finish the job. What did Joab say would happen otherwise?

answers.text: He would capture it and it would be named after him
The Ammonites would win back the royal fortress
The Ammonites would call in more soldiers to help

questions.question: When David went to capture the Ammonite city of Rabbah, how many of his troops did he gather?
After David captured Rabbah, he took the Ammonite king's crown. What metal was the crown made of?
After David captured Rabbah, what did he do with the people who lived there?

answers.text: Put them to work with tools and at brick kilns
Sent them away to live in a far land
Made them stand guard over the city walls
